docs.title: Brand guidelines
lines: # Logo
Use the full Meridian logo on white or deep teal. Keep clear space equal to the height of the M.
# Colors
Deep teal #0E3B4F, Meridian teal #18A594, coral #F06B4F for highlights only.
# Type
Geist for everything. Bold for headings, regular for text.
# Tone
Plain words, short sentences, no jargon.

docs.title: Presentation template
lines: # Layouts
Title, section divider, one big number, chart, quote and team slides.
# Tips
One idea per slide. Use the chart colors in order. Put sources in the footer.

docs.title: Expense report template
lines: # Before November 2
Use this template, attach receipts and send it to your manager.
# From November 2
Use the new expense app instead. Photograph your receipt and submit.

docs.title: New starter checklist
lines: # Day 1
Collect your laptop, set up a passkey, meet your buddy.
# Week 1
Read the handbook, acknowledge the code of conduct, book your plant visit.
# Month 1
Agree your 30-60-90 day plan with your manager.

docs.title: Organization chart
lines: # Leadership team
Dana Whitaker (CEO), Marcus Oyelaran (COO), Michael Torres (CFO), Priya Natarajan (People), Samuel Okafor (Engineering), Luis Ramirez (Plant).
# Departments
Eight departments across Austin, Tulsa, Denver, Rotterdam and remote.

docs.title: 2027 benefits guide
lines: # Plans
Meridian Base and the new Meridian Plus, with a $750 deductible.
# Enrollment
October 12 to 30 in the benefits portal.
# Help
Office hours on October 14, or email the People team.

docs.title: IT equipment request form
lines: # What you can request
Monitors, headsets, keyboards, mice, docks and chargers.
# How
Fill in the form and send it to the service desk. Standard items ship in 3 days.

docs.title: Legal review request
lines: # When to use it
Any customer, supplier or partner contract, and any NDA that is not on our standard template.
# Turnaround
Five working days for standard reviews.

docs.title: Press boilerplate and fact sheet
lines: # About Meridian Waterworks
Meridian designs and builds smart water meters and filtration controls for cities and utilities.
# Media questions
Send every press inquiry to the communications team.

docs.title: Travel booking guide
lines: # Flights
Economy for flights under six hours. Book at least 14 days ahead.
# Hotels
Use the preferred hotels near each office.

docs.title: Performance review template
lines: # For managers only
Use this form for the year-end review. Write evidence, not adjectives.
# Ratings
Exceeds, meets, developing. Calibrate with your VP.

docs.title: Quarterly business review deck
lines: # For managers only
Q3 results by department and Q4 targets.
# Do not forward
Confidential. Share the headlines with your team, not the deck.
